title: Enterprise Fastpass Lane for Model Variants & Safe Sunset
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Goal: Create a clearly-scoped 'Fastpass' intake lane for customer-driven model variant requests (new model adds, version pin requests, and deprecation scheduling) that prioritizes enterprise customers while preserving stability guarantees. The Fastpass lane should enable a short, auditable path for high-value customers to request a model variant or temporary pin with automated evaluation gates, controlled traffic shaping (shadow -> canary -> staged roll), and an explicit stability buffer for safe sunset/deprecation. This ticket covers the PM-level spec, acceptance criteria, stakeholder sign-offs, and coordination points with engineering, design, and support teams.

Scope:
- Intake form changes and required metadata for Fastpass (business justification, SLA need, compliance flags, expected traffic profile).
- Automated lightweight eval gate that runs a small labeled prompt set + embedding drift check within 24h; pass/fail thresholds included.
- Pin duration defaults and extension workflow (default 14 days with extension flow for enterprise contracts).
- Safe sunset buffer: when deprecating a model variant, customers using Fastpass get a guaranteed 30-day stability buffer and migration assistance.
- Rollout steps: shadowing -> 1% canary -> 10% staged -> full (with automatic rollback triggers tied to latency/cost/regression metrics).
- Dashboard telemetry: per-request visibility (pin owner, start/end, traffic percent, eval results) and automated notifications to owners and customer success.

Out of scope: full catalog policy rewrite, large-scale model onboarding automation, and any changes to billing models (billing implications will be surfaced but handled in separate ticket).
acceptance_criteria: Intake form template published in Confluence and wired to the intake UI (fields required: customer, justification, expected qps, compliance needs, contact)
Automated eval pipeline (small labeled set + embedding drift) executes within 24h for Fastpass requests and produces a pass/fail score visible in the ticket
Pin provisioning flow implemented: creates a temporary pin record, applies traffic shaping, and tags the customer usage for billing/observability
Default pin timeout set to 14 days with a documented extension approval flow owned by Products & Customer Success
Deprecation buffer policy documented and surfaced to customers automatically when a pinned variant is scheduled for sunset
Runbook for rollback triggers (latency > 2x baseline, token cost regression > 20%, eval failure) exists and is validated with a tabletop exercise
Dashboard widgets for Fastpass pins and active rollouts are available in Console staging and show sample telemetry
